title: Reducto assessment
snippet:
Entry price$150 in free credits, Standard Parse from $1 per 1,000 pagesFull pricing detail

Standard usage includes $150 in free credits and up to five Studio seats, then charges by the operation and number of pages. Parse costs $1 per 1,000 pages on r-1 mini or $10 on r-1, Extract and Split $20, Deep Extract and Deep Split $40, Classify $7.50 and Edit $60, with batch jobs 20% cheaper on Parse and Extract.
Growth adds volume discounts, unlimited seats, EU and Australian residency endpoints and zero data retention, and Enterprise adds VPC and on premises deployment, role based access control and SSO with SAML. Both are quoted, and teams moving from another document processor can apply for up to $5,000 in migration credits. Reducto holds SOC 2 Type II attestation.

Free tier
What is public
Reducto charges $1 per 1,000 pages for Parse on r-1 mini or $10 on r-1 under Standard. Extract and Split are $20, Deep Extract and Deep Split $40, Classify $7.50, Deep Classify $15 and Edit $60 per 1,000 pages, or $15 for fully prefilled pages. Extract, Split and Classify include parsing. Standard also carries up to five Studio seats. Growth and Enterprise rates depend on volume and contract terms.
Billing mechanics
Eligible Parse and Extract jobs run through the batch queue at a 20% discount with a 12 hour completion guarantee. Dense extractions over 100 fields per page can incur a surcharge. Standard includes $150 in free credits for eligible accounts.
